authRefusal.reason: A refusal supplies no wait time. Do not promise shortly, parse server prose, or start an invented cooldown.

invitationTokenPolicy.linkLocation: Fragment only, never URL path or query. Normal HTTP request URLs and access logs omit it.
invitationTokenPolicy.exchange: Extract locally; pass only to the authorized exchange endpoint in a protected request body. Disable/redact body and header logging for credentials, including tokens; fragment placement alone is not protection against every log.
invitationTokenPolicy.allLogs: No token in reverse-proxy, application, request-body, error, crash, breadcrumb or debug logs.
invitationTokenPolicy.analytics: No token or raw invitation URL. Only spec 36 allowlisted events with pseudonymous IDs (T51).
invitationTokenPolicy.web: No token in HTML metadata, referrer, App Store link, social previews or third-party requests. Do not interpolate a server message into UI.

travellingRows.week: Recurring weekday has no travel-zone time; dated occurrences are in the local-times sheet.
travellingRows.differentDates: Both time lines include their own exact date. Home plaque/occasion remain club date. Friends uses friends.date.club.dated.
travellingRows.targetYear: Always include year in proposed start/boundary/preserved-announced dates and their VO; elsewhere include year if outside contextual current year, crossing a year, no clear year context, or standalone specimen. Both time-zone representations use the same year inclusion policy; exact VO targets always include year. Snapshot current-year live Home/Friends omit year; comparison explicitly includes it.

selfName.occasions: Title/start: handoff5.occasion.self. Embedded sentence: handoff6.occasion.self.inSentence. Named other-person occasion uses actual name.

deniedHeader.title: handoff6.header.denied.brand
deniedHeader.reason: Avoid using a denied selected-club record or cache; own account identity is separate.
deniedHeader.selectedId: Keep failed navigation identity internally so denial is explicit; never substitute another club.
deniedHeader.allTabs: Home/Friends/Memories same denial; selected tab changes only. Own global account photo may remain; no cached club metadata.
deniedHeader.Add: Private draft, then Open my drafts; no selected-club target. Another eligible club only by explicit authorized choice.
deniedHeader.GetHelp: Configured Tadayo support contact via native contact action. No support address is invented in these frames.
deniedHeader.leading: brand wordmark, action token, 96 points; noninteractive Tadayo identity
deniedHeader.oneChooseAction: Exactly one Choose a club in body, primary action/onAction. Thus Voice Control does not number duplicate Choose a club buttons. The old primaryText/action selector is retired, not recoloured.

switcherStatus.why: Avoid conflating the proposed roster with active membership; status already explains availability.
switcherStatus.eligibleListing: Unavailable appears only for a club still in the authorized club listing; a revoked club is omitted.
switcherStatus.selected: Native checkmark + spoken selected trait; no cover colour, lock, next date or countdown.
switcherStatus.selectedVO: Label excludes Selected; native selected trait adds it once.
switcherStatus.activeRows: Book fixture: Kitchen table, 5 people · Next: Maya. Count is authorized active members; unavailable row has no count/date/person.

pastDayCard.basis: Keep 2.1 H01-after-close on every Home; filled H5 card and Memories glyph retired.

spacing.basis: Gaps measure line-box edges, not baselines or ink bounds. A pinned footer may leave extra flexible space beyond its minimum; no fixed 77-point content gap.
spacing.filledRows: Canvas gap of 4 between individually rounded rows; no fused corners.

confirmationNavigation.Back: Pop G04 completion to stored safe origin Home or Schedule, never editable choice list. Done does the same. If origin unavailable, Home resolves current authorization state.
confirmationNavigation.confirmedOwnRow: Defined for picker restored/deep-linked later: read-only check/Confirmed, no selector, edit or action.

defaultsAssessment.FQ79: Prevents instant reveal but a confirmation less than 24h before its weekday opening can defer the first date by a week. Display the real resolved date wherever dates are shown; no invented intermediate reveal.
defaultsAssessment.FQ46_FQ48: Non-chooser can join a contested day without seeing existing names beforehand. Explain in hint, avoid suggesting anyone should leave.
defaultsAssessment.FQ55: A day may remain contested indefinitely. No pressure or automatic winner.
defaultsAssessment.FQ57: Read-only after confirmation is clear but changes require membership-change workflow in trial.
defaultsAssessment.FQ16: Restart only on accepted and approved membership; no new ruling about departed members’ announced days.
